entries.description: A sentence-embedding encoder that turns text into 768-dimensional unit-norm vectors served natively through the embeddings endpoint. The 8-bit affine quantization (group 64) keeps the whole model resident in about 0.16 GB of wired GPU memory, and each input is capped at 8192 tokens.
entries.architecture_summary: ModernBERT base encoder, 149M parameters, 22 layers, hidden 768, 8192-token input

entries.description: The smallest Qwen 3.5 dense VLM as a 4-bit affine MLX quant. Chat, reasoning, tool calls, and image understanding in about 0.65 GB of wired GPU memory, with a 262144-token context window and enforced structured outputs. Also the compact drafter for speculative prefill acceptance journeys.
entries.architecture_summary: Qwen3.5 dense VLM, 0.8B parameters, 24 layers, hidden 1024, 12-layer vision tower

entries.description: The smallest member of the Qwen 3.5 family as a 4-bit affine MLX quant. Chat, reasoning, tool calls, and image understanding in about 1.75 GB of wired GPU memory, with a 262144-token context window and enforced structured outputs.
entries.architecture_summary: Qwen3.5 dense VLM, 2B parameters, 24 layers, hidden 2048, 297-tensor vision tower

entries.description: A static mixed-precision OptiQ quant of the Ornith 1.5 9B dense vision-language model, targeted at 4.5 BPW and achieved at 4.63 BPW (group 64, affine). Takes images and text, reasons before answering, and bundles a multi-token prediction head for speculative decoding. Language tensors are a 4/5/6/8-bit mix; the vision tower stays bf16. Image input and MTP require mlx-optiq.
entries.architecture_summary: Qwen3.5 dense VLM, 9B params, 32 layers, 27-layer vision tower

entries.description: A local text-to-image model that creates one lossless PNG from a prompt.

A mixed-precision OptiQ quant of the Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts vision-language model, per-layer 4/8-bit affine (group 64). Takes images and text, reasons before answering, and bundles a multi-token prediction head for speculative decoding. The MoE architecture registers through OptiQ; the bf16 vision tower stays in a separate vision sidecar and the int4 MTP head stays in optiq/mtp.safetensors; image input and MTP require mlx-optiq.
entries.architecture_summary: Qwen3.5 MoE VLM, 35B total params, ~3B active (A3B), 40 layers, 256 experts, 8 routed per token. bf16 vision tower and int4 MTP head via OptiQ

entries.description: A static mixed-precision OptiQ quant of the Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B mixture-of-experts vision-language model, targeted at 5.5 bits per weight, with per-layer 4/6/8-bit affine scaling (group 64). Takes images and text, reasons before answering, and bundles a multi-token prediction head for speculative decoding. The MoE architecture registers through OptiQ; the bf16 vision tower stays in a separate vision sidecar and the int4 MTP head stays in optiq/mtp.safetensors; image input and MTP require mlx-optiq.
entries.architecture_summary: Qwen3.5 MoE VLM, 35B total params, ~3B active (A3B), 40 layers, 256 experts, 8 routed per token. bf16 vision tower and int4 MTP head via OptiQ

entries.description: A 33B-parameter sparse mixture-of-experts reasoning model for coding and agentic work, with about 3B active parameters per token. Takes text, reasons before answering, and calls tools natively. Under one memory ceiling, experts stream from SSD when they do not fit, without hidden quantization. Text-only, about 27.2 GB on disk.
